Review a survey in three moves

  1. Import survey and re-flight folders in any order.
  2. Use the rectangle or polygon tools to select a review area. Choose Select oldest in matches or Select newest in matches to choose which side of each match to remove.
  3. Choose Exclude selected, then copy the final list to a folder or download a CSV. Nothing is deleted from your source drive.
